**In one line**: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reportedly defended his stance on open-weight AI models after facing criticism from Palantir CEO Alex Karp.

### Key points
- According to Fox Business, Amodei pushed back in defense of open-weight (publicly released model weights) after Karp's critique.
- Open-weight distribution makes a model's parameters public so anyone can download, run, and modify them — placing the tradeoff between openness and safety at the center of an industry debate.
- Palantir and Anthropic appear to hold opposing views on how AI should be developed and released.

### Why it matters
Whether to release open weights cuts to the core tension between accelerating AI's spread and retaining safety control. With the heads of a frontier lab and a defense-and-data firm clashing publicly, the exchange could ripple into coming debates over regulation and industry standards.
